$description: Hand-maintained reasons for tokens emitted into tokens/tokens.css that no documented consumer (src/core, core/*.js, examples, site, tests/browser) reads. tools/token_map.py fails on any emitted token that is neither consumed nor listed here. Keep this list small: prefer wiring a token up over adding a reason.

tokens.--acc-ink: Primitive behind the semantic `interactive-ink` alias; shipped core uses `--text-soft`/`--ink-soft` for accent-on-ink text.
tokens.--dur-guidance-nudge: Continuous-loop motion for the Android camera mask guidance (slow tilt gesture); no shipped web consumer.
tokens.--dur-guidance-pulse: Continuous-loop motion for the Android camera mask guidance (breathing brackets / lock pulse); no shipped web consumer.
tokens.--dur-view-desktop: Motion duration reserved for desktop view transitions; shipped core consumes `--dur-view-in`/`--dur-view-out`/`--dur-view-phone`.
tokens.--dv-1: Data-viz categorical palette; consumed by downstream chart code, not by the shipped CSS.

tokens.--interactive-ink: Semantic alias for accent text on ink; no shipped rule reads it yet (available to products).
tokens.--lh-tight: Tight heading line-height; shipped headings rely on the base line-height.
tokens.--log-secondary: Semantic alias for log secondary text; shipped log rows use `--code-fg`/`--log-time`.
tokens.--radius: Policy zero: core enforces `*{border-radius:0 !important}`, so the token documents the policy rather than being read with `var()`.
